entities.name: PMID:25435628
observations: He and Gao reported that protopine inhibits heterotypic adhesion between MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells and HUVECs.
The study tested five Corydalis yanhusuo alkaloids; only protopine showed anti-adhesive and anti-invasive effects.
After 90 minutes of treatment, western blotting showed reduced EGFR, ICAM-1, αv-integrin, β1-integrin, and β5-integrin.
The authors attributed the adhesion inhibition to altered expression of adhesive factors.

entities.name: Protopine
observations: Protopine reduced heterotypic adhesion of MDA-MB-231 cells to HUVECs in the reported study.
Its effect was associated with down-regulation of multiple adhesion-associated factors: EGFR, ICAM-1, αv-integrin, β1-integrin, and β5-integrin.

entities.name: MDA-MB-231
observations: Human breast cancer cells used in a heterotypic adhesion model with HUVECs.

entities.name: HUVEC
observations: Human umbilical vein endothelial cells used as the heterotypic adhesion partner for MDA-MB-231 cells.
